files: engine GLBs pistol.glb, shotgun.glb, smg.glb made from FBX Pistol_4, Shotgun_2, SubmachineGun_2
notes: The raw zip was not edited. Engine GLBs were converted in Blender and normalized to meters: pistol length 0.24, shotgun 0.78, smg 0.46, barrel along +Z, grip end nearer the origin. Original FBX dimensions were about 2m, 5.8m, and 4m on the long axis.
